scenarios.name: Plant 200 street trees
scenarios.why: Trees on the sunniest walkway spots, 8 m apart
scenarios.cost_basis: ASSUMED: 6000 rupees per tree with three years of care, 3500 rupees per square metre of new footpath. Not quotes.
scenarios.assumptions: each new tree is 8.0 m tall with a 3.0 m crown; trees at least 8.0 m apart

method.demand: trips from building floor area plus through traffic at the site edge (about a third of trips), 3200 sampled origin-destination pairs, congestion-aware routing (BPR, 4 stages)
method.scaling: ASSUMED: demand scaled so the 95th percentile link is at 90% of capacity in a peak hour
method.limits: No traffic counts were used. Read the ranking and the relative changes, not the vehicle numbers.

solutions.title: Pedestrian overbridge or underpass
solutions.what: Walkers leave the carriageway, so turning cars stop less
solutions.assumption: ASSUMED: +5% capacity once crossing conflicts are removed
solutions.cost_basis: ASSUMED unit rates in rupees, not quotes: bus lane 8 lakh per km, signal retiming 6 lakh, new signal 15 lakh, foot overbridge 3.2 crore, extra lane 1.5 crore per km, route signage 2 lakh; per-km items are priced on at least 100 m

solutions.title: Divert some trips to a parallel street
solutions.what: Signage and turn rules that send 15% of through trips around
solutions.assumption: ASSUMED: 15% of trips using the busiest link follow the signs, if the detour is under 60% longer
solutions.cost_basis: ASSUMED unit rates in rupees, not quotes: bus lane 8 lakh per km, signal retiming 6 lakh, new signal 15 lakh, foot overbridge 3.2 crore, extra lane 1.5 crore per km, route signage 2 lakh; per-km items are priced on at least 100 m

solutions.title: Add signal control
solutions.what: No signal is mapped here: a timed signal that follows the queues
solutions.assumption: ASSUMED: +12% effective capacity from timed control
solutions.cost_basis: ASSUMED unit rates in rupees, not quotes: bus lane 8 lakh per km, signal retiming 6 lakh, new signal 15 lakh, foot overbridge 3.2 crore, extra lane 1.5 crore per km, route signage 2 lakh; per-km items are priced on at least 100 m
